tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
row = u[u.instance_id=='i-a272bb8eabd6'].iloc[0]
cur = c[c.instance_type==row.instance_type].iloc[0]
req_vcpu = cur.vcpu * row.p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7
req_mem = cur.memory_gib * row.p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8
print(req_vcpu, req_mem)
fam = c[(c.family==cur.family) & (c.vcpu>=req_vcpu) & (c.memory_gib>=req_mem)]
print(fam.sort_values('hourly_usd'))

import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
row = u[u.instance_id=='i-a272bb8eabd6'].iloc[0]
cur = c[c.instance_type==row.instance_type].iloc[0]
req_vcpu = cur.vcpu * row.p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7
req_mem = cur.memory_gib * row.p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8
fam = c[(c.family==cur.family) & (c.vcpu>=req_vcpu) & (c.memory_gib>=req_mem)]
rec = fam.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0].instance_type if len(fam) else row.instance_type
print(rec)
